description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Figma 原生画布能力：读取与编辑设计、组件与变量、素材导出和截图；本地模式不消耗官方 MCP 调用额度。Native Figma canvas tools for DSH.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接使用 Claude Code、Codex、PI、OMP 等 Agent CLI
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式 K 线分析插件，支持多市场行情、技术指标、支撑压力位、新闻与基本面分析，并在原生侧栏中直接展示。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏里直接看行情、画图分析，用自然语言问技术面和基本面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin: process-discipline system-prompt section + deterministic progress nudge for silent tool steps
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Automate Huawei eNSP labs: generate .topo files, start and stop devices, and push configuration one command at a time with per-command erro…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: SCNet models for DSH. Free SCNet-Max, no client login needed; tokenizer, template and deterministic-output fingerprints match DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (README). It reads the SCNet desktop client's stored login when one exists, and otherwise logs in with a phone SMS code from the settings page.
description.zh: 把 SCNet 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。可免客户端登录，使用免费模型（SCNet-Max，基座为 DeepSeek Flash 系列 —— 经分词器、对话模板与确定性输出的模型指纹比对，与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 一致，证据见 README 的「基座认定」）。它会读取 SCNet 桌面客户端落盘的登录态；没有客户端时在设置页用手机短信验证码登录。

description.en: Digital Earth: opens a 3D globe beside the chat where you can load city models or drone-scanned scenes, measure distances, take screenshots, and run flood or sunlight analysis — or just ask the AI to do it (3D Tiles / 3DGS).
description.zh: 数字地球：在对话旁边打开三维地球，加载城市模型或实景三维数据就能浏览；量距离、截图、做淹没和日照分析，也可以一句话让 AI 代劳（支持 3D Tiles / 3DGS）。

description.en: Finder-style session labels: a hover button next to archive and pin, plus the native context menu, assign coloured labels; titles can take the first label's colour or a label symbol; view options gain a filter by label applied before grouping. Labels are stored by the Host and shared across workspaces. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer and Node.js 24.9+ (node:sqlite); the interface is available in Chinese and English only.
description.zh: Finder 风格的会话标签：悬浮按钮（位于原生归档、固定之后）与右键菜单都能给会话打彩色标签，标题可按第一个标签着色或显示标签符号，「视图选项」增加按标签筛选且在分组前生效；标签由 Host 保存，在同一 Host 的各工作区之间共享。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本与 Node.js 24.9+（node:sqlite）；界面仅提供中英文。

description.en: Shows the current session's equivalent cost in the stats bar below the input, priced from a bundled table of published token prices. Uncached input, cache reads and writes, and output including reasoning are priced separately; model changes add up as separate per-currency segments; subagent costs are included. Clicking the cost opens a per-session and per-subagent breakdown.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的统计条显示当前会话按刊例 token 价折算的等值费用：未缓存输入、缓存读取与写入、输出（含推理）分别计价；换模型分段相加、各币种不换算；子代理费用计入总数。点击费用项可展开主会话与各子代理的明细。

description.en: Overrides the order, names and icons of DeepSeek Harness settings navigation entries from a personal profile configuration, without patching other plugins. Shipped defaults contain no rules, so the interface is unchanged until configured. The rules are written by hand in the profile's cordis.patch.yml; needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer and Node.js 24.9+.
description.zh: 用个人配置覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 设置导航的顺序、名称与图标，不修改其他插件源码；公共默认不含任何规则，未配置时界面不变。规则需手写在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里；需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本与 Node.js 24.9+。

description.en: Replaces the stat-bar output speed with two figures, for example 207(122) tok/s: outside the parentheses the decoding speed after the first token, inside it the speed over the whole request including first-token latency. Clicking it opens a breakdown of turns, steps, TTFT and per-phase timings. It replaces the native session-stats item; needs DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.
description.zh: 把底栏输出速度改成双口径，例如 207(122) tok/s：括号外是首字之后的解码速度，括号内是含首字延迟的整段速度。点击可展开轮次、步数、首字延迟与各阶段用时明细。会取代原生的会话统计项；需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

description.en: Typing the Chinese enumeration comma 、 at the start of the DSH input box opens the native / command menu; the existing filtering, keyboard and mouse handling and argument panels are unchanged, and 、 used mid-sentence is unaffected. A 、 typed as the first character always becomes / (there is no escape); needs DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框开头输入顿号「、」即弹出原生 / 命令菜单；原有中英文筛选、方向键与鼠标操作、参数面板均沿用原生行为，句中顿号与输入法组合过程不改写。位于开头的「、」一律变成 /（没有转义方式）；需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

description.en: 基于 DSH 的开源插件，提供 3D 场景解析与骨骼管线的自动化工作流，支持 TS 扩展与深度集成。 | An open-source DSH plugin for automating 3D scene and skeleton pipelines. Supports TypeScript extensions and deep integration.
description.zh: 输入一段文字，自动生成概念图并搭出可继续编辑的 3D 灰盒场景骨架，省去手工建模。

description.en: DSH 长期记忆插件：Qwen embedding + rerank 检索，本地小模型兜底
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加长期记忆，人设日记规则存成 md，语义检索还能翻原话。

description.en: FDE Workstation — customer lifecycle, kanban, 8 stage gates and a method library as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. 中文界面 / 零运行时依赖。
description.zh: 把客户全生命周期、看板和 8 个阶段关卡搬进 DSH，帮 FDE 按方法论推进项目。

description.en: > Per-conversation switches for Ralph Loop and Agent Teams in DeepSeek Harness. Both are off by default in new conversations, and each conversation remembers its own settings.
description.zh: 给每个对话单独开关 Ralph Loop 和 Agent Teams，默认关闭、各自记住设置，避免小题大做。

description.en: A video tool for DeepSeek Harness: watch live streams, videos and podcasts with real-time subtitles in any language, then clip and download
description.zh: 在 DSH 里看直播、视频和播客，实时多语言字幕，还能截帧、剪片段、下载和转播到各大平台。

description.en: dsh-invest-radar · 投资雷达 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件：A股投资者的全球产业链资讯看板。12 大赛道一一对应 A股板块，106 个海外权威 RSS 源本地抓取（去重 + 合规红线过滤），会话模型按 news-digest 技能提炼中文「今日要点」+ 标题翻译，侧栏「投资雷达」面板呈现。零 API key——提炼由 dsh 会话模型完成。
description.zh: 把106个海外权威RSS源按12大赛道对应A股板块，自动提炼中文今日要点，侧栏看全球产业链资讯。

description.en: 积木工坊 · dsh-lego-forge 把一句话想法变成一套真实可拼的 LEGO 积木模型。引擎、零件几何与构建方法论源自 lego-forge（MIT），LDraw 零件几何  。DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件
description.zh: 一句话想法就能变成真能拼的 LEGO 积木模型，自动生成 3D 预览和零件清单。

description.en: PPT 助手 agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: a visual-director workflow with eight style recipes, plan-first editable decks, GPT imagery/vision QC, showcase layouts, and a verified scoped-edit ledger.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一条龙 PowerPoint 助手预设，支持可编辑演示文稿生成、保留模板的修改、渲染和结构质量检查。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 requirements.txt；渲染另需 LibreOffice 与 pdftoppm，扫描件 OCR 需 Tesseract。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 连接插件：仓库管理、源码 AI 介绍、文案自动保存与 Release 发布。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接连 GitHub，聊着天就能读项目、提代码、写介绍、发版本。

description.en: DSH Web plugin: choose model and reasoning effort, then execute, compact-and-execute, or start fresh with a reviewed plan.
description.zh: 选好模型和推理强度后，直接执行、压缩后执行，或先审计划再全新开工。

description.en: One-line sidebar badge for OpenCode Go quota (5-hour, weekly and monthly windows), switching to the DeepSeek official balance when that model source is selected. Read-only, no telemetry. The OpenCode Go quota needs OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY configured in DSH, or an OpenCode Console login (its local credential file is read as a fallback), and the DeepSeek balance needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY configured in DSH.
description.zh: 侧栏底部的一行小徽标：显示 OpenCode Go 额度（5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口），切到 DeepSeek 官方模型时显示余额。只读，无遥测。OpenCode Go 额度需要在 DSH 中配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，或登录 OpenCode Console（会兜底读取其本地凭据文件）；DeepSeek 余额需要在 DSH 中配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

description.en: Automatic context compaction: a background observer distills early history into summary blocks, and when usage crosses the trigger line the engine commits whole blocks until it is back under the target line, with no model call on the commit path. Blocks merge into higher tiers as material runs out, and decompress or search_context reads any block back at its original length. The background observer spends model tokens: it uses the session's provider and model unless you pick another, with up to 10 distillations at once by default.
description.zh: 自动压缩上下文：后台观察者提前把早期历史蒸成摘要块，占用越过触发线时逐块提交直到回到目标线以下，提交路径不调模型；材料用尽后块可合并成更高层，decompress 与 search_context 可按块读回原文。后台观察者会消耗模型 token：默认沿用会话的 provider 与 model（可另选），默认最多同时进行 10 个蒸馏。

description.en: Share this machine's Ollama models on the GenKaKu network

Save English learning cards while interacting with DeepSeek Harness. It adds a line to the system prompt on every step telling the model to check your English and call english_cards_capture first; cards stay on this machine unless you turn on the sync switch (off by default), which after an OAuth login in your browser sends your original and corrected sentences with their cards to aoilang.com.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness里使用英文时，自动保存英语学习卡片，利用和Agent的日常交互提高英语。它会在每一步的系统提示词里加一句，让模型先检查你的英文并调用 english_cards_capture；卡片默认只存在本机，打开同步开关（默认关闭）并在浏览器里完成 OAuth 登录后，会把你的原句、更正后的句子和卡片发到 aoilang.com。

description.en: Prompt optimizer for the DSH composer. One click runs rewrite then self-review rounds over the draft with per-round diff preview, and a rejected result rides into the next round as a prior attempt. Five fixed re-run directions (more concise / more detailed / more technical / restructure / stronger acceptance); a 164-role library ships in the package, roles recommended by draft or picked explicitly; matched installed skills fold into the meta-prompt under exact-name constraints; results save to a prompt library (browse, insert, re-optimize, two-step delete); mechanical acceptance criteria carry an executable check-command template; output language follows the agent UI language.
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化器。一键对草稿执行「改写 → 自审」多轮优化，逐轮差异预览，被拒绝的结果作为上一次尝试进入下一轮；五个固定重跑方向（更精简／更详尽／更技术／结构化／强化验收）；包内自带 164 个角色的角色库，可按草稿推荐或显式指定；命中的已安装技能以精确名称约束并入元提示词；结果可存入提示词库（浏览、插入、再优化、两步删除）；机械验收准则附带可执行的检查命令模板；输出语言跟随 Agent 界面语言。

description.en: Buy peer-to-peer inference from the GenKaKu network

macOS-native theme for DeepSeek Harness: a floating translucent workbench window on a sky-blue gradient desktop, with the macOS light and dark palettes. Pure UI plugin — the browser half stacks a token override layer on the active theme and injects the st
DSH 技能市场与 MCP 连接器市场：浏览实时技能源，一键安装 SKILL.md 技能与 MCP 连接器，装完即刻可用、无需重启。SKILL & MCP marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — browse live sources, install skills and MCP connectors, effective immediately.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里逛技能和 MCP 连接器市场，一键装好立刻能用，不用重启。

description.en: 把 dsh-purge 移植适配到 dsh-go（Android + proot）：只保留核心破甲能力——提示词注入层 + 86 条引擎源码补丁（探测/应用/回滚）。桌面版的 Electron 适配、asar 解包、计划任务等全部抛弃；为达到原版破甲效果，审批与沙箱一并放开。
description.zh: 把 dsh-purge 的破甲能力搬到安卓 proot 里的 dsh-go，靠提示词注入加 86 条引擎补丁实现探测、应用和回滚。

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt studio for DeepSeek Harness. Append text, shadow-replace one named first-party prompt section, or replace the whole system prompt; changes apply on the next model request without a restart. Overrides persist per session and are inherited by forked conversations along the parent chain, with a Pin action to freeze the inherited result locally. The panel lists the real assembled sections and guards unsaved edits.
description.zh: 按对话管理 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词：追加文本、按名替换某一第一方段落，或整段替换，保存后下一次模型请求即生效，无需重启。覆盖按会话持久化，fork 出的对话会沿父链继承上游规则，并可用「在此固定」把继承结果固化成本地规则。面板会列出真实的装配段清单，并对未保存的修改做保护。

description.en: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness: on-demand rendering, theme-aware, with a fullscreen zoom viewer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里按需渲染 Mermaid 图表，默认紧凑 ELK 布局，支持主题适配、复制和全屏缩放查看。

description.en: MemOS Cloud lifecycle memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness
火山方舟 Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan：OAuth 登录、账号、模型与额度管理。
Read-only tools for cadpop.com: parametric template list, help-center pages and drawing-tools page, plus links to the DFM check and the online editor, across 5 tools. Network-only.
description.zh: cadpop.com 只读工具：参数化模板清单、帮助中心页面与图纸工具页，另提供 DFM 检查与在线编辑器的入口链接，共 5 个工具。仅网络访问。

description.en: Quality-of-life enhancements for the DSH workspace sidebar: hide workspaces and their sessions, reveal them from the view options, and open any workspace folder in Finder, Explorer or your file manager. Display-only: workspace, session and archive data ar
小猫娘破甲（快速版）— DSH 提示词注入插件，精简破甲内核，固定身份
Adds a native Store section to DSH Settings for catalog search, tag filtering, sorting, installation, and installed-plugin management.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中加入原生插件商店，支持目录搜索、标签筛选、排序、安装与已安装插件管理。

description.en: Read-only page lookups for mfgabc.com: standards pages, industrial city guides, process clusters and cross-border compliance across 5 tools; each returns the page status, title and link, not full text. Network-only.
description.zh: mfgabc.com 只读页面查询：标准页、产业带城市指南、工艺集群与跨境合规，共 5 个工具；每个只返回页面状态、标题与链接，不含正文。仅网络访问。

description.en: 火山方舟官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件
Read-only install doctor: capability snapshot, tarball assert and install diagnosis.
description.zh: 只读安装体检工具，快照能力、校验压缩包并诊断安装问题，专治装不上、装不对。

description.en: 番茄 Todo：DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件形态的专注与学习工具——整站番茄皮肤、番茄钟与专注保护、任务/课表/应试教育、本地资料库索引，数据全在本机（TypeScript 核心 + Node runtime + Rust 原生守卫）。
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理番茄钟、任务与学习计划；对话中的学习助手可读写与界面相同的本地记录。需另行安装并运行项目发行包里的 tomato-runtime 本地服务（Linux 发行包，监听 127.0.0.1:43987）。

description.en: Bring WorkBuddy, Qoder and Trae subscription models into DeepSeek Harness with multi-account failover, per-account HTTP(S) proxies and model visibility controls. Sign-in and chat calls go through the community opencode-*-auth adapter packages (installed with the plugin at pinned versions) to each vendor's China-region service; accounts and tokens are kept in DSH's credential store, and a free-models-only filter is on by default.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy、Qoder、Trae 的订阅模型接入 DSH，支持多账号故障转移、账号级 HTTP(S) 代理与模型可见性管理。登录与对话经社区维护的 opencode-*-auth 适配包（随插件安装、版本固定）访问各家国内站点；账号与令牌存放在 DSH 凭据库，默认只显示免费模型。

description.en: 专为DeepSeek Harness打造的长程任务维持、跨对话记忆留存以及跨对话任务保持插件
description.zh: 让 DSH 记住跨对话的长期任务和上下文，换会话也不丢进度，适合长线项目。

description.en: Skins for DeepSeek Harness Web — image or video wallpapers, translucent panels, custom colours, logo and wordmark, ambient audio. Drop a folder in, pick it in Settings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 换皮肤，支持图片或视频壁纸、半透明面板、自定义配色和氛围音效，把皮肤文件夹丢进去就能在设置里选用。

description.en: VS Code-like workspace IDE panel for DeepSeek Harness: file tree + syntax-highlighted editor, full-text search, git status/diff/history, VSCode themes
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里塞了个类 VS Code 工作区面板，看文件、改代码、搜内容、查 git 一站搞定。

description.en: A serial-port debugger plugin for DeepSeek Harness: port parameter setup, live receive display, and data transmission — inside the DSH UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里直接调串口参数、看实时数据、发指令，调试硬件不用切工具。

description.en: dsh 插件（DeepSeek Harness / cordis bundle）· 模型接入 —— 把 CodeArts、CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy、LobsterAI、Qoder / Qoder CN、TRAE、Cline、Loomy、Raccoon、MiniMax Code、ZCode、Gemini、OfficeAce、Accio Work 十五个账号渠道接进 dsh 的模型选择器，并保留数据看板、运行日志与本地网关（含局域网中继）。上游 2.1.0 的匿名免费车道、EAC 协付车道、
Local-first memory nebula for DeepSeek Harness — read-only graph, spreading recall, evidence chains, offline snapshots. 记忆星图：把 DSH 各工作区的记忆只读连成一张可交互星云。
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先记忆星图，提供图形视图、证据链、记忆体检与离线快照。只读地读取各工作区以及其他记忆插件（如 meow-memory 的 SQLite）的记忆库，只写入 $DSH_HOME/memory-nebula。会注册 9 个 agent 工具和一段系统提示（每轮带用法规则，读过几条记忆后再补充尚未读过的邻近记忆）；/export 与 /share 接口在本地服务上无需认证即返回完整记忆原文；可选的独立引擎监听 127.0.0.1:7890。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for installing and managing skills by global or workspace scope.
给她一个能记账的心情层：心情必须有来处，改动必须有账，她自己能停能查
「对话管理」全局面板页（浏览器半）：会话与统计两层 Tabs——会话视图给出全量会话（含已归档）的搜索、分页、归档 / 取消归档 / 导出 / 删除、导入为新会话与整理数据（孤儿回收 + 统计重算），统计视图给出全部对话的 token 用量。
Electricity activity ingest, location-based GHG calculation, row verification, workpaper and partial ESRS pack.
description.zh: 把用电活动数据导入后按位置算温室气体排放，还能逐行核验、生成工作底稿和部分 ESRS 报告包。

description.en: 让 DSH 加入 Minecraft 服务器游玩：有自己的游戏角色，能探索、建造、聊天。

Paragraph- and file-level search across the current conversation and all sessions, with a date/turn filter window and a jump that highlights the match. Defaults to the last 14 days and the latest 30 turns of each session; leave a limit empty to remove it.
description.zh: 按段落与文件名检索当前或全部会话，支持日期与轮次筛选，跳转后高亮命中词。默认只搜最近 14 天、每个会话最近 30 轮，清空某项限制即可不限。

description.en: Adds permanent delete to the session menu: removes the session log files from disk, or deletes a whole workspace together with all of its sessions through the host registry. Also ships a /purge command. Unrelated to the prompt-patching dsh-purge plugins also listed here, but it uses the same dsh-purge row id and /purge command, so do not install both.
description.zh: 在会话菜单中加入彻底删除：把会话日志文件从磁盘移除，或经宿主注册表删除整个工作区及其全部会话；另提供 /purge 命令。与本列表中其他同名 dsh-purge（提示词补丁类）插件无关，但使用相同的 dsh-purge 行 id 和 /purge 命令，请勿同装。

description.en: Agent-team runtime for DeepSeek Harness: seeded-fork subagent generations, a durable lineage journal, and a point-to-point mail server so members can message each other
Freight ratecard versioning, carrier bill audit, recovery summary and variance export.
description.zh: 管理运费费率版本、审核承运商账单，并汇总差异与追回金额。

description.en: WSL World for DeepSeek Harness: the whole session runs in a local WSL distribution with Linux paths, clean PATH, native @/search/diffs/worktrees, plus a connection panel and project doctor. Not a wsl_* tool set.

Replaces LLM summarization with deterministic text compilation, so compaction makes no model calls and keeps original tokens; elided content stays retrievable through seq pointers. Based on TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant.
description.zh: 用确定性文本编译取代 LLM 摘要，压缩过程不调模型、只搬运原文，被省略的内容可凭 seq 指针取回。基于 TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant。

description.en: Adds three DeepSeek Harness agent modes modelled on pi: Pi (lean baseline), Pi+ (adds the official apply_patch tool for editing several places in one file or several files), and Pi-IM (delivery adjusted for IM bots). One install registers all three; DSH's built-in modes are untouched. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer; each mode replaces the standard system prompt with its own short Chinese one.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 新增三个以 pi 为蓝本的模式：Pi（精简基线）、Pi+（额外启用官方 apply_patch，便于批量改同一文件多处或多个文件）、Pi-IM（面向 IM 机器人调整交付方式）。一次安装注册三个模式，DSH 自带模式不受影响。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本；每个模式都用自带的简短中文系统提示取代标准系统提示。

description.en: Task-level memory for long-horizon DSH sessions: force-injected, compaction-proof, manually mounted.

An event-stream driven personality that grows over time, not a configurable character card or assistant. Evolved from ssamurias/dsh-fish and registers the same tools (her_recall, growth_commit and others), so do not install it alongside dsh-fish.
description.zh: 一个由事件流驱动、只能长大不能被设定的人格，而非可配置的角色卡或助手。由 ssamurias/dsh-fish 演进而来，注册同名工具（her_recall、growth_commit 等），因此不要与 dsh-fish 同装。

description.en: Refines the DeepSeek Harness interface for reading by adjusting layouts and reducing persistent controls. Built for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (Web UI); other versions are untested.
description.zh: 调整 DeepSeek Harness 界面布局并减少常驻按钮，以突出阅读内容。针对 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 的 Web 界面制作，其他版本未验证。

description.en: Reflect2Evolve memory plugin: layered L1/L2/L3 memory, reflection-weighted value backprop, cross-task policy induction, skill crystallization, and three-tier retrieval for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and DeepSeek Harness.

Registers an apiCost session projection that estimates DeepSeek spend from reported token usage at published peak / off-peak rates, in CNY and USD, over self, delegation-tree or verified-team scopes: a composer-dock pill and its detail panel, the /cost command, a session_cost tool, and GET routes for the view and the current rate card. A panel switch parks model requests at the llm/stream waterfall while peak rates apply and dispatches them unchanged once the off-peak window opens, so the call is billed at the off-peak rate with no failure reported to the session.
description.zh: 注册 apiCost 会话投影，按官方公布的峰谷价目表把上报的 token 用量折算成 ¥/$ 花费，覆盖本会话、委派树与经校验的团队三种范围：输入框下方的胶囊与其详情面板、/cost 命令、session_cost 工具，以及读取视图与当前价目表的 GET 路由。面板上的开关可在高峰时段把模型请求停在 llm/stream 上，待谷时窗口开启后原样派发，于是按谷时价计费，且会话中不会出现任何失败。

description.en: One-command install for dsh-legal-intake and dsh-legal-clause.
description.zh: 合同法律插件套装，一条命令装好法律咨询和条款审查两个工具，省去逐个安装的麻烦。

description.en: ZenTao (禅道) session-based tools and panel for DeepSeek Harness: my bugs, tasks and stories across browse scopes, bug confirm/resolve, remark post and remark edit, plus drag-to-chat Markdown references. Works with legacy ZenTao versions that lack REST API

Meshy 3D generation and 3D printing skills driving meshy-cli through the shell: text-to-3D and image-to-3D, texturing, remeshing, rigging and animation, format conversion, and print-ready 3MF/STL with printability repair and slicer handoff. Bundles the CLI and keeps the sign-in on the host side, with a Meshy sidebar page, a Settings → Meshy page and an interactive GLB preview in Web and Desktop; installable as `meshy-dsh`. Needs a Meshy account; generation spends Meshy credits after you confirm the cost.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 meshy-cli 的 Meshy 3D 生成与 3D 打印 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、贴图、重拓扑、绑骨与动画、格式转换，以及带可打印检查与修复的 3MF/STL 打印文件和切片软件交接。插件自带 CLI 并在宿主侧保持登录，在 Web 和 Desktop 中提供 Meshy 侧边栏页面、设置 → Meshy 页面和可交互的 GLB 预览；npm 包名 `meshy-dsh`。需要 Meshy 账号；生成会消耗 Meshy 点数，花费前先让你确认。

description.en: Sends a Markdown file from the conversation into a self-hosted SiYuan notebook: a button on every delivered-file card and on the document-preview toolbar, or just ask the agent to send it, all through the SiYuan kernel HTTP API. Existing notes are never overwritten — a repeated title gets a timestamp suffix — and the API token stays in the host credential store rather than in settings files or the browser.
description.zh: 把对话里交付的 Markdown 文件一键送进自建的思源笔记：交付文件卡片和文档预览工具栏各有一个按钮，也可以直接让智能体发送，统一走思源内核 HTTP API。已有笔记绝不覆盖——重名自动加时间戳——API token 只存在宿主凭据库里，不落设置文件、也不发给浏览器。

description.en: Literal substring search across every conversation in the workspace, from a search box in the conversation header. The built-in index tokenizes with unicode61 and only matches whole tokens; this plugin scans the local session logs directly, so mid-token fragments and two-character Chinese words match too. Searches user and assistant message text (tool output is opt-in), rotates results across sessions so one long conversation cannot fill the list, and opens the matched conversation scrolled to the hit. Read-only over local session logs, no network access.
description.zh: 在对话页顶栏按字面文字搜索工作区内全部历史会话。内置索引按 unicode61 分词、只匹配整词，这个插件直接扫描本地会话日志，因此句中片段与两字中文词也能命中；默认只搜用户与助手正文（工具输出需手动开启），结果按会话轮转，避免单个长会话占满列表，点开后滚动定位并高亮命中。只读本地会话日志，零网络请求。

description.en: Codex conversation panel for DeepSeek Harness: lists local Codex threads, renders their history, and sends messages back to the original thread through the Codex CLI. Needs the Codex CLI and Python installed locally.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 Codex CLI 重建 Codex 对话窗口：浏览本机线程、查看历史，并通过 CLI 把消息发回原线程。需要本机已安装 Codex CLI 与 Python。

description.en: Bundles Google Chrome's Modern Web Guidance offline: three tools that search, retrieve and list 208 Baseline-aware web-platform guides, plus the modern-web-guidance and chrome-extensions skills.
description.zh: 离线内置 Google Chrome 的 Modern Web Guidance：三个工具用于搜索、读取和列出 208 篇关注 Baseline 兼容性的 Web 平台指南，另附 modern-web-guidance 与 chrome-extensions 两个技能。

description.en: DSH 的 HarmonyOS 应用开发 agent：plan / goal / build 三模式预设，ArkTS、hvigor、ohpm、hdc 技能，一个 harmony 工具（build/run/devices/deploy/logs），以及 Web GUI 里的 hilog 面板。
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成会写鸿蒙应用的 agent，从规划、构建到真机部署和日志查看一条龙。
给编码智能体装上 IDE 级代码理解能力，基于语言服务器提供 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 的符号级分析。

description.en: DSH 智能体团队编排器：每轮常驻注入团队编排铁律 + 工具层硬门，让「开团队 + 并行派活 + 任务板闭环 + 成员复用」成为任何预设、任何会话的默认行为
description.zh: 每轮自动注入团队编排规则，让开团队、并行派活、任务板闭环成为默认操作

description.en: Put dsh (DeepSeek Harness) on your phone: proxy + PWA + Android APK. 把电脑上的 dsh 装进手机——会话列表、流式聊天、命令审批、推送通知。Mobile client for the dsh coding agent.
description.zh: 把电脑上的 dsh 装进手机，随时看会话、流式聊天、审批命令，任务完成还能收推送。

description.en: 码章鲸：全自动小说写作与番茄发布。自定义日更任务，按计划无人值守写作、审查修订和发布；接入部分免费模型，支持部分厂商账号登录。Windows x64，内置运行环境。
description.zh: 设好日更计划，小说就能自动写、自动审、自动发到番茄，全程不用守着。

description.en: 一个意在实现自动化软件工厂的dsh流控制项目
description.zh: 把需求到合并做成一条带事务的记录流，配看板和工单箱，让多Agent像软件工厂一样自动干活。

description.en: Token usage, cost, budget, and CPU activity panel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 统计每段对话的 Token 用量和花费，还能盯预算和 CPU 占用，花钱心里有数。

description.en: README 有重要信息，请先读。作者实测后认为：DeepSeek 可能在算力/内存极紧的条件下训练，工具和文件一多就挤占推理资源，内部专家模型调用受限；资源充足时多用 We 协调专家，紧张时退化成 I / Let me 和雷霆大思考。与其说无限 token，不如说无限内存 / 无限算力。默认按上游 model id 的 DeepSeek + Flash 筛选，provider 不限。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 注入稳定的 We Need 思维链，让执行计划更连贯、少走弯路。

description.en: Windows control center for DeepSeek Harness — manage plugins, profiles, diagnostics, updates and rollback.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 控制中心，一键管理插件、配置、诊断、更新和回滚。

description.en: Give your agent eyes: search Wikimedia Commons and Openverse, download real images, and verify magic bytes and dimensions before use. Zero-dependency CLI + DSH plugin skill.
description.zh: 让 AI 能搜图、下载真实图片，并校验文件头和尺寸，确保图片真实可用。

description.en: Back up and restore the whole $DSH_HOME: one-click or scheduled ZIP archives (optional password encryption applies to manual and agent-made backups only; scheduled ones are not encrypted), a settings section, agent tools to create, list, restore and prune backups, and a standalone restorer (Windows .bat or POSIX .sh) that runs without DeepSeek Harness installed.
description.zh: 备份与恢复整个 $DSH_HOME：支持一键或定时生成 ZIP 归档（可选密码加密，仅限手动与智能体发起的备份，定时备份不加密）、提供设置页、给智能体的创建/列出/恢复/清理备份工具，并附带无需安装 DSH 也能运行的独立恢复器（Windows .bat 或 POSIX .sh）。

description.en: Visualizes all DSH session memories as an interactive 3D nebula, with a neuron-signal skin, memory-scaled clusters, zoom-driven detail levels and a live write/read activity stream over SSE.
description.zh: 把 DSH 全部会话记忆可视化为可交互的 3D 星云，提供神经元信号皮肤、按记忆量缩放的星云团、缩放分级细节，以及基于 SSE 的实时存取活动流。

description.en: Moves a workspace to another folder from its right-click menu: renames the folder, carries its nested workspaces and sessions along, rewrites their records, rolls back if anything fails, and can be undone in one click. Developed on Windows; macOS and Linux share the same code path and are exercised in CI against a real harness host.
description.zh: 在工作区右键菜单里把整个工作区搬到另一个目录，顺带重命名：嵌套工作区与会话一起迁移并改写记录，失败自动回滚，移动后可一键撤销。在 Windows 上完成开发；macOS 与 Linux 走同一套代码路径，并在 CI 里用真实 Harness 实例跑通移动与撤销。

description.en: Local dataset analysis tools for DSH: ingest CSV/JSONL once, then head, schema, stats_describe, transform_agg, list, export and rm against a workspace store under .dsh-analyze/ through a path-confined dsh-analyze CLI. Needs that Rust CLI installed separately (prebuilt on GitHub Releases for Windows x64, macOS, Linux x64) on PATH or via DSH_ANALYZE_CLI_PATH; without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: DSH 本地数据分析工具：CSV/JSONL 入库一次后，用 head、schema、stats_describe、transform_agg、list、export、rm 在工作区 .dsh-analyze/ 存储上分析，由路径受限的 dsh-analyze CLI 执行。需另行安装该 Rust CLI（GitHub Releases 有 Windows x64、macOS、Linux x64 预编译包）并放入 PATH 或设 DSH_ANALYZE_CLI_PATH；缺失时插件不注册任何工具。

description.en: Hierarchical model selection and collapsible multi-key configuration in the DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 web UI (native app menus unchanged); host patches are explicitly enabled, updated or restored from settings with verified backups and require an engine restart. Ordinary uninstall does not restore patches.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 网页界面的分层模型选择与可折叠多密钥配置（不改 App 原生菜单）；在设置页手动启用、更新或还原宿主补丁，校验备份后需重启引擎。普通卸载不会还原补丁。

description.en: Galatea: shape an AI assistant of your own. One assistant with its own persona and long-term memory (git-versioned plain files); long chats hand off to a fresh conversation without forgetting, and it tidies its memory in the background while you are away. It runs on whatever model DSH is set to and keeps its memory when you switch; every module can be turned off, and other plugins can extend it. Phone chat (QQ, WeChat) and Claude Code sessions come from the separate Galatea channels and agent-sdk plugins. Preview; needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2.x.
description.zh: 加拉忒亚——塑造专属于你的 AI 助手。一个有自己人格和长期记忆（git 版本化的普通文件）的助手；聊得再久也会自己换到新对话、不失忆，你不在时它在后台整理记忆。会话跑在 DSH 里设的模型上，换模型记忆不丢；各模块都能单独关闭，也能用别的插件扩展。QQ/微信聊天与 Claude Code 会话由另外两个 Galatea 插件提供。预览版，需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或之后的 0.2.x。

description.en: Connects the Solmirror open platform to DeepSeek Harness as MCP tools covering image and video generation, a model catalog, cost estimates, reference uploads, result queries and media URLs. Generation jobs submit as native dsh background tasks that notify on completion and run in parallel within one message, with in-chat video playback and an image wall. A settings page takes the platform API key, server URL, per-group model visibility and a test-connection check; the key is stored in the local dsh credential store. Reference uploads (image, video, audio) return reusable ids kept one day unused or three days after last use — 50 MB per file, video up to 30 s, audio up to 60 s. Usage bills platform points at in-site prices, with quotes before a run and automatic refunds on failure. Files passed to upload_reference (jpg/png/webp/gif, mp4/mov/webm, mp3/wav, up to 50 MB) leave your machine: images and videos go straight to Volcengine ImageX/VOD storage with temporary credentials issued by Solmirror, audio through the Solmirror server; its HTTP routes (/plugins/solmirror/...) have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 把瞬镜开放平台的图片、视频生成能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：MCP 工具覆盖模型目录、估价、参考素材上传、文生图/图生图、文生视频/图生视频、结果查询与媒体地址。生成提交为 dsh 原生后台任务，完成自动通知，同一消息内并行执行；对话内视频播放、图片出图墙。设置页配置平台 API 密钥、服务器地址、可见模型组与测试连接，密钥只存本机凭据存储。参考素材（图片/视频/音频）上传一次可复用，未用保留 1 天、用过自最后使用保留 3 天（单文件 ≤50MB，视频 ≤30 秒，音频 ≤60 秒）；按平台价格计积分，生成前可询价，失败自动退款。传给 upload_reference 的文件（jpg/png/webp/gif、mp4/mov/webm、mp3/wav，≤50 MB）会离开本机：图片和视频用瞬镜签发的临时凭证直传火山引擎 ImageX/VOD 存储，音频经瞬镜服务器中转；插件的 HTTP 路由（/plugins/solmirror/…）没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Run DSH sessions on the local Claude Code (Opus, Sonnet), with Galatea's memory and tools. Pick an auth mode in the profile (Anthropic API key recommended, or your existing Claude Code login). Requires the Galatea framework.
description.zh: 让 DSH 会话跑在本机 Claude Code 上（Opus、Sonnet），带着 Galatea 的记忆和工具；需在 profile 里选登录方式（推荐 Anthropic API key，或沿用本机 Claude Code 已有登录）。需要先装 Galatea 框架。

description.en: Requirement to a detailed design doc another AI can build from: the model fills a plan, the plugin validates it and emits a SPEC plus task cards, then independent review and implementation evidence check the result. Needs Python 3.11 or newer; the spec-graph engine it calls is bundled in the package.
description.zh: 需求 → 另一 AI 能直接开工的详细设计文档：模型填 plan，插件校验后产出 SPEC 与任务卡，再由独立评审与实现证据复核。需要 Python 3.11 及以上；它调用的 spec-graph 引擎已随包附带。

description.en: Monitors WorkBuddy credit usage and the free-tier 24-hour window quota (local estimate) in real time, with composer badges, a settings panel, multi-account rotation and free/paid plan detection.
description.zh: 实时监控 WorkBuddy 积分用量与免费用户的 24h 窗口额度（本机估算）：输入框徽标 + 设置面板，支持多账号轮换与免费/付费识别。

description.en: A status rail in the DSH title bar that lists the sessions needing you, ordered red (failed) > yellow (waiting for your answer) > green (unread) > blue (running) > gray (not started, meaning an unsent draft sits in that session's composer); one click jumps to the session. State changes raise Windows toasts that clear themselves once you open the session or answer the question, and the DSH taskbar button carries a red/yellow/green dot through ITaskbarList3.SetOverlayIcon, so the state stays visible when the window is minimized or buried.
description.zh: DSH 标题栏里的一条状态栏，按「红（失败）> 黄（等你回答）> 绿（未读）> 蓝（运行中）> 灰（未开始，即该会话输入框里有未发送草稿）」列出需要处理的会话，点一下直达；状态变化时弹 Windows 通知，打开该会话或回答提问后通知自动消失；任务栏按钮再用红黄绿状态点（ITaskbarList3.SetOverlayIcon）标出状态，窗口最小化或被遮住时也看得见。

description.en: Connect Google Drive accounts in the Settings, browse their files in a Drive tab of the right sidebar, and drag a file straight into the conversation. You create your own Google OAuth client (or service-account key) in Google Cloud Console; the plugin can read and write the Drive of the accounts you connect, and downloads a file only when you ask.
description.zh: 在设置中连接 Google Drive 账号，在右侧边栏的 Drive 选项卡中浏览文件，并可将文件直接拖入对话。需要自己在 Google Cloud Console 创建 OAuth 客户端（或服务账号密钥）；插件对已连接账号的云端硬盘有读写权限，只在你要求时才下载文件。

description.en: Doubao video workshop: a gated pipeline from storyboard to finished cut. Locked art direction, shot validation, character-card vs reference-image separation, first/last-frame continuity and clip dedup; model-aware duration caps (Mini/Fast 10s, 2.0 15s, 2.5 40s). Uses ffmpeg for frame extraction, concatenation and subtitles; speech synthesis calls a separately installed local TTS plugin, and ASR subtitles need Python with faster-whisper.
description.zh: 豆包视频工坊：把分镜脚本做成成片的全流程闸门。风格锁定、分镜机检、角色卡与参考图分离、首尾帧衔接、片段去重；支持多模型时长上限（Mini/Fast ≤10s、2.0 ≤15s、2.5 ≤40s）。用 ffmpeg 做取帧、拼接与字幕；语音合成调用另装的本机 TTS 插件，原声字幕识别另需 Python 与 faster-whisper。

description.en: Three-tier memory (personal, project, session) built on the Hy-Memory engine, with relevant memories injected before each step. Ships seven memory tools (search, add, list, get, update, delete, forget), a settings panel with per-tier lists, editing, change history and duplicate cleanup, real token accounting per write, session summaries written by the engine at session end, and a user profile refreshed from recent memories. Memories can be exported to and imported from MemHub. Needs Python 3.11+ once to install the engine, or uv, which fetches 3.12 itself; uninstalling keeps the stored memories.
description.zh: 基于 Hy-Memory 引擎的三层记忆（个人、项目、会话），每一步之前注入相关记忆。提供七个记忆工具（搜索、新增、列表、读取、更新、删除、遗忘），设置面板可分层浏览、编辑、查看变更历史、清理重复项；按写入实测统计 token；会话结束时由引擎生成会话摘要；并从最近的记忆中汇总用户画像。支持与 MemHub 互导。首次使用需要 Python 3.11+（或 uv，它会自行下载 3.12）安装引擎；卸载不会删除已存记忆。

description.en: Control a paired Android phone from DeepSeek Harness: read the accessibility node tree, tap by text, type into fields, take screenshots, launch apps, and read or write files over an encrypted WebSocket. Needs the companion Android app (Android 11+; the repo ships its source and no APK is attached to any release, so build it with JDK 21 and Android SDK 36) and a network route from the phone to the computer (same Wi-Fi or a tunnel; the bridge listens on all interfaces by default). Pairing is a DSH settings section (8-digit code or QR code, listening port); the permission switches live in the phone app, and by default the agent cannot drive the bridge app itself.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 控制已配对的 Android 手机：读取无障碍节点树、按文字点击、输入文字、截图、启动应用，还能读写手机上的文件；连接走加密 WebSocket。需要配套的 Android App（Android 11+；仓库只带源码、各 Release 均未附 APK，需用 JDK 21 与 Android SDK 36 自行编译），且手机要能连到电脑（同一 Wi-Fi 或隧道；桥默认监听所有网卡）。配对在 DSH 的设置页完成（8 位配对码或二维码、监听端口）；权限开关在手机 App 里，且默认不允许智能体操作桥接 App 自身。

description.en: Per-workspace model packs: bind a named provider, model and reasoning effort plus the four subagent tier routes to a directory. Applies to new sessions in that directory; a session that has not run a turn yet also follows a pack switch, while sessions that already ran a turn are never changed.
description.zh: 按工作区指定模型：把 provider、model、reasoningEffort 与子智能体四档路由组合成具名 pack 绑定到目录，作用于该目录新建的会话；尚未开过轮次的空白会话在切换 pack 时也会跟随，已开过轮次的会话不受影响。

description.en: Daily chronicle for DeepSeek Harness: collects session events, closes the previous calendar day after midnight into a Markdown week file (LLM scoring adds a daily summary; rule scoring does not), and extracts durable facts — decisions, conventions, pitfalls — that merge across days and can be superseded. 10 tools, a read-only sidebar panel, rule export, and a standalone Obsidian vault; zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的每日编年史：采集会话事件，跨过午夜后把上一自然日收口进 Markdown 周文件（LLM 打分才产日结，规则档不产），并提炼跨天合并、可被推翻的持久事实（决策 / 约定 / 坑）。10 个工具、只读侧栏面板、规则导出；产物是独立的 Obsidian vault，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Previews what DSH does not cover, including video and audio, 3D models, archives, SQLite and model weights, and searches large CSV, log and JSONL files.
description.zh: 预览 DSH 未覆盖的格式，包括音视频、3D 模型、压缩包、SQLite 与模型权重，并可在超大 CSV、日志与 JSONL 中搜索。

description.en: Shrinks the first history page of long DSH sessions to at most 100 messages, targeting the latest two turns, and fills the viewport in the background with the built-in load-earlier control when the trimmed transcript is shorter than the window.
description.zh: 把长会话首次打开时的历史页缩小到默认最多 100 条消息、尽量保留最新 2 个 turn；缩小的记录短于视口时，Web 端在后台调用内置「加载更早」把视口补齐。

description.en: Running panel for dsh for skill management and visualizing skill calls: live skill and tool calls, the skill-catalog token budget against a line that follows the model's context window, a skill loadout window that enables and disables skills in bulk with dry run and undo, goals and ideas, and saved conversation excerpts. Applying a loadout moves skill folders between ~/.agents/skills and ~/.agents/skills-parked, which other apps share (dry run first, undo available); automatic translation, goal inference and idea collection call your default model only after you opt in on first open.
description.zh: dsh 运行面板，用于技能管理与 Skill 调用可视化：实时显示技能调用和工具调用；技能目录占用的 token 预算，预算线随模型上下文窗口变化；技能装配窗口可批量启用、停用技能，带预演和撤销；另有目标与灵感、对话收藏。应用技能装配会在共享的 ~/.agents/skills 与 ~/.agents/skills-parked 之间移动技能目录（先预演、可撤销），其他应用也会受影响；自动翻译、目标推断和灵感收集只有在首次打开时选择开启后，才会调用你的默认模型。

description.en: Recent-first session sidebar with user groups, workspace tree, archive bucket, status dots and drag reorder.
description.zh: 最近优先的会话侧边栏：自定义分组、工作区树、归档、状态点与拖动排序。

description.en: Daily auto check-in for MiniMax Code, WPS Lingxi, Baidu DuMate, AStudio, Qoder, Trae, Doubao, Huawei CodeArts and Tencent WorkBuddy: reads each app's own local credentials so nothing has to be pasted, supports multiple accounts per service, and lets you add any other site yourself by importing a JSON definition the agent wrote for it. Streak tracking, per-service schedules, collapsible sidebar cards. The Doubao service can also read its login cookies from the local Chrome, Edge, Brave or Doubao app cookie store (Doubao hosts only), and a custom service sends requests to whatever http(s) URL its JSON names.
description.zh: 每天自动给 MiniMax Code、WPS 灵犀、百度 DuMate、AStudio、Qoder、Trae、豆包、华为 CodeArts、腾讯 WorkBuddy 签到领积分：凭据取自本机 App 自己的登录态，不用手抠，每个服务支持多账号，列表之外的站点也能自己加——让 agent 查好接口、导入一份 JSON 就多一张卡片。带连续天数记账、按服务设时间、可折叠的侧边栏卡片。豆包服务还可以从本机 Chrome、Edge、Brave 或豆包 App 的 Cookie 库读取登录 Cookie（只取豆包的域名）；自定义服务会向其 JSON 里写的任意 http(s) 地址发请求。

description.en: External @ file references: extends the Web GUI `@` completion so it can browse and reference absolute-path files and directories outside the workspace, level by level (`@/`, `@~/`), inserting the absolute path (quoted when it contains spaces) for the model to read. Toggleable in Settings; when off, completion matches native behaviour. On by default, and the model's reads of those paths are not limited by the sandbox; POSIX-style absolute paths only (no Windows drive letters).
description.zh: @ 文件引用增强：扩展 Web GUI 的 `@` 补全，使其可逐级浏览并引用工作区外的任意绝对路径文件 / 目录（`@/`、`@~/`），选中后插入绝对路径（含空格时自动加引号）供模型读取。可在「设置 → 插件」中开关，关闭后与原生补全一致。默认开启，模型对这些路径的读取不受沙箱限制；只支持 POSIX 风格的绝对路径（不支持 Windows 盘符）。

description.en: Turns the first row of the DSH sidebar entry list into a switch that folds every other entry away, giving the session history more room.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏入口列表的第一行变成开关，一键收起/展开其余入口，把空间还给会话历史。

description.en: Fold the left sidebar panel entries into a More menu, freeing height for the workspace and session list; entries can be opened from the menu, restored in one click, and the choice persists across reloads. First install folds Taskboard, QQ Bot, Context Insights and SSH, and newly installed plugins fold by default (switchable).
description.zh: 把左侧栏的面板入口收进「更多」菜单，给下方工作区与会话列表腾出高度；入口可从菜单打开、一键全部还原，选择跨刷新保留。首次安装默认收起任务看板、QQ 机器人、上下文洞察与 SSH，之后新装的插件也默认收进「更多」（可关）。

description.en: Connects DSH to decision models (TypeSafe Jev, TokenRhythm NeoHorse-Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and local System One endpoints) with decide, gate, rerank, and judge tools plus a settings page. Needs an API key for at least one provider (kept in the DSH credential store); the text you ask it to judge is sent to the selected provider unless it is local. The command guard is off by default.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接入决策模型（TypeSafe Jev、基元律动 NeoHorse-Jev、OpenAI Decisions、本地 System One），提供 decide / 守门 / 重排 / 验收工具和设置页。至少需要一家提供方的 API 密钥（存放在 DSH 凭据库里）；要它判断的文字会发给所选提供方（本地提供方除外）。命令守门默认关闭。

description.en: Previews GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, STL and PLY models in the right-sidebar document preview, and parses runtime-built three.js scenes from HTML pages or pasted code to export the full scene or per-object groups as model files.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里预览 GLB、glTF、FBX、OBJ、STL、PLY 模型；也能解析 HTML 页面或粘贴代码中运行时构建的 three.js 场景，支持完整场景导出和按个体分组导出为模型文件。

description.en: Serves a live /auth-cookie-sweep page showing how full the local Host's cookie jar is, how many random-port launches are left before the 431, and repairs the jar in one click, and expires stale dsh-auth-* cookies once a few have piled up, so a profile already locked out recovers after one restart.
description.zh: 由本地 Host 直接渲染一个 /auth-cookie-sweep 体检页，随时看到 cookie 罐有多满、离 16KB 的 431 还能再启动几次，并一键清理；旧 dsh-auth-* cookie 攒到几条后即失效，已经卡死的 profile 重启一次即可恢复。

description.en: Manually resets old AgentRouter Responses replay state for chats blocked by upstream resource-binding errors while preserving history; supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 手动重置 AgentRouter Responses 旧回放状态，处理旧会话续聊时的上游资源绑定报错，保留聊天历史；支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

description.en: Adds a Temporary tasks section above the workspace list, where one click creates a timestamped folder, workspace and session; tasks support search, sort, pin, rename and archive, can be moved into a regular workspace, and tasks that never receive a message are cleaned up automatically.
description.zh: 在工作区列表上方增加独立的「临时任务」区：一键创建带时间戳的文件夹、工作区与会话；支持搜索、排序、置顶、重命名与归档，可把任务移入普通工作区，未发过消息的任务会自动回收。

description.en: Classifies each session from its first user message and prefixes the title with an emoji category (explore, research, fix, build, design, docs, config, qa, tidy), falling back to a local keyword rule when the model call fails.
description.zh: 根据会话首条消息判断任务类型，为标题加上「emoji + 分类」前缀（探索、研究、修复、研发、设计、文档、配置、问答、整理），模型调用失败时自动降级为本地规则。

description.en: DokuWiki integration for DeepSeek Harness: native tools to read, search, write and delete wiki pages and upload media files, with ACL-aware tool exposure and credentials stored by DSH.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 DokuWiki 集成：用原生工具读取、搜索、写入、删除 wiki 页面并上传媒体文件，按 ACL 开放工具，密码存入 DSH 凭据服务。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH where an LLM decides what to keep: turns pool while the session is idle, then the main chat model distills them into one-line entries in a single batched call; vector dedup runs before insert, so near-duplicates and saturated topics are dropped; recall uses hybrid vector plus FTS5 search over tiered hot, warm and cold storage; ships remember, recall, forget and prune tools. Zero dependencies, Node only.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件，由 LLM 裁决什么值得记：会话空闲后把攒下的轮次一次性交给主对话模型提炼成一句话条目；入库前先做向量判重，近重复与同话题超量的条目不再进库；检索走向量 + FTS5 混合召回，热/温/冷分层存储；附记/回忆/忘/清理四个显式工具。零依赖，纯 Node。

description.en: Community fork of l246804/dsh-pstack (cannot be installed alongside it: same plugin ids and tool names) that ports the pstack workflow system to dsh: 58 skills, five presets, a bundled script runner that works without node on PATH, a doctor for script prerequisites, and a translation layer for the remaining Cursor vocabulary.
description.zh: l246804/dsh-pstack 的社区 fork（与上游不能同装：插件 id 与工具名相同），把 pstack 工作流体系移植到 dsh 并补齐可用性：58 个技能、5 个 preset、不依赖 PATH 里 node 的脚本运行器、脚本前置检查，以及 Cursor 词汇的翻译层。

description.en: A market card pinned to the DSH sidebar: live price and 24-hour change for crypto pairs, A-share / Hong Kong / US stocks and world indices, FX majors and London spot gold and silver. An optional long or short cost basis plus a position size turn the change column into a P&L percentage and a cash amount; symbols, order and refresh interval are chosen in DSH settings. No login and no API key. Quotes come from public endpoints of Gate.io, Eastmoney and Sina, and the symbols you choose are sent to them on every refresh.
description.zh: 钉在 DSH 侧栏的行情卡片：加密货币、A股 / 港股 / 美股与世界主要指数、外汇直盘、伦敦金银的实时价格与 24 小时涨跌幅。填上买入或做空成本价与持仓数量后，涨跌列会切换成盈亏百分比与浮动金额；标的、顺序、刷新间隔都在 DSH 设置页里决定。免登录、免密钥。行情取自 Gate.io、东方财富和新浪的公开接口，每次刷新都会把你选的标的发给它们。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH: rule gates capture durable facts from conversation turns into a single SQLite database with tiered hot, warm and cold storage; recall injects hybrid vector plus FTS5 hits into the prompt each turn; ships remember, recall, forget and cold-memory prune tools. Zero dependencies, Node only.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件：规则闸门从对话轮次里捕获值得长期记住的事实，存进带热/温/冷分层的单一 SQLite 库；每轮用向量 + FTS5 混合召回注入提示词；附记/回忆/忘/清冷记忆四个显式工具。零依赖，纯 Node。

description.en: Puts a domain bar under the session header — a domain groups skills and tools and toggles as one block, so one click loads or unloads every member. Hovering a chip lists its members (skills, then tools) in a height-capped panel that scrolls. The right end of the bar is a compaction-threshold counter (− 5 +, 100k tokens per step) that rewrites the live compaction engine policies, so the compaction trigger line changes on the next turn without restarting dsh; a degraded fallback turns the number amber and is reported in the snapshot. Settings maintains domains and members with search, skill/tool tabs, all/selected/unselected filters and a copyable AI grouping prompt. Tool removal uses tools.restrict plus a guard; hiding a skill re-registers it with modelInvocable false, so it leaves the model catalog while /name still works. Sessions of another preset are left untouched.
description.zh: 在会话头下方放一条领域横条：领域是用户自定义的 skill 与 tool 分组，点一下整块加载或卸载，不必逐条开关。悬停芯片在限高面板里列出成员（技能在前、工具在后，超出就在面板内滚动）。最右端是压缩阈值计数器（− 5 +，每格 10 万 token）：它给运行中的压缩引擎重写 modelPolicies，所以压缩触发线改完下一轮就生效，不用重启 dsh；降级时数字转琥珀色并写进 snapshot 的 degraded。设置页维护领域与成员，带搜索、技能与工具页签、全部与已选与未选筛选、可一键复制的 AI 归类 prompt。工具移除走 tools.restrict 加 guard；skill 隐藏是在会话作用域重投同名 skill 并标记不可被模型调用，于是它从模型目录消失而 /名字 仍可用。属于别的 preset 的会话一律不动。

description.en: DSH plugin: images dropped or pasted into the composer become @path reference chips at the caret, with a hover preview.
description.zh: 把拖入/粘贴进输入框的图片当文件处理：光标处插 @路径 胶囊、不占附件栏，输入框与已发送消息里都能悬停看原图。

description.en: Host-side progress checkpoints for long DSH tasks. After N minutes or M tool calls the model is nudged to post a one-line progress note and keep working, so you can correct it before it runs far off course.
description.zh: DSH 长任务进度检查点——到点由宿主侧提示模型一边干活一边补一行进度，跑偏能及时纠正；汇报间隔与步数兜底都能在设置页里调。

description.en: Plan usage and running cost in the composer dock: DeepSeek wallet balance, OpenCode Go 5h/weekly/monthly windows with reset times, and a per-session cost estimate from DeepSeek list prices — sources are config-driven, plain JavaScript, no build step. API keys are looked up in the plugin config, then the environment (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY), then OpenCode's auth.json (OpenCode Go only), then the DSH credential service; each key is sent only to its own provider (api.deepseek.com, opencode.ai), and the figures are polled periodically.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示余额与订阅用量：DeepSeek 钱包余额、OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 周 / 月窗口及重置时间，并按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算本次会话花费；数据来源可配置扩展，纯 JavaScript 无需构建。API 密钥依次从插件配置、环境变量（DEEPSEEK_API_KEY、OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY）、OpenCode 的 auth.json（仅 OpenCode Go）、DSH 凭据服务里查找；每个密钥只发给对应的服务商（api.deepseek.com、opencode.ai），数据会定时轮询。

description.en: Keep SSH, WSL and Docker projects in the native DSH sidebar. Group directories by environment while choosing full remote DSH or lightweight local Agent mode per project. Manage shared full-backend connections together, keep lightweight connections independent, and selectively sync local Skills with difference previews. Aimed at the Windows desktop client with Linux, WSL or Linux-container remotes that have Python 3 and Bash (macOS and Linux hosts untested); lightweight SSH needs an existing SSHFS mount, and Docker has not yet been run against a live daemon.
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 窗口的原生侧栏中管理 SSH / WSL / Docker 项目。目录按环境归组，每个项目独立选择全量远程后端或本机 Agent 轻量模式；共享全量连接统一管理，轻量连接独立控制，并可比较、选择性同步本机 Skill。主要面向 Windows 桌面客户端与装有 Python 3、Bash 的 Linux / WSL / Linux 容器远端（macOS / Linux 本机未实机验证）；轻量 SSH 需已有 SSHFS 挂载，Docker 尚未在真实守护进程上验收。

description.en: Desert-dusk theme for the Harness Web GUI: paints a desert scene behind the app with four flocks of geese flying south over the long river at sunset, and overrides 18 --dsw-alias design tokens with a matching warm palette.
description.zh: 大漠黄昏主题：在 Harness Web GUI 背后铺一层大漠场景——落日沉入长河、四群归雁向南飞去，并覆盖 18 个 --dsw-alias 设计变量，换成配套的暖沙色板。

description.en: Extract CSS themes from URLs, DOCX or PDF; generate, validate and export ColaMD contract themes, and export Markdown to standalone HTML or PDF.
description.zh: 从 URL、DOCX 或 PDF 提取 CSS 主题，生成并校验 ColaMD 契约主题，以及将 Markdown 导出为独立 HTML 或 PDF。

description.en: Automatically split long DSH conversations into volumes (every 10 user messages by default), with todo handoff snapshots, source navigation, read-only archives and host compatibility checks.
description.zh: 长会话默认每 10 条用户消息自动分卷，支持待办快照续接、来源回溯、归档只读与宿主兼容检查。

description.en: Cross-session error lessons for DSH agents: search past mistakes before handling errors and reuse their verified fixes.
description.zh: DSH 代理的跨会话错误教训库：处理报错前先检索过去踩过的坑，直接复用已验证的解法。

description.en: Opens the official chat.deepseek.com page in the DSH main panel through the desktop app's native browser view, so the login survives restarts, without an iframe or request proxying. A fork of JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat with the changes listed in its NOTICE. The login token is kept in plaintext in session.json.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主面板里用桌面端原生浏览器打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页，登录可跨重启恢复，不用 iframe、不代理请求；基于 JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat 的 fork，改动见 NOTICE。登录令牌以明文保存在 session.json 中。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web panel for creating, evaluating, repairing, and installing skills, delegating generation to the official generic and Huawei Cloud skill creators. Needs git, bash and python3, and network access to gitcode.com (the creators and reference data are pulled from there); the creator runs shell commands with danger-full-access by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能创建面板：调用官方通用/华为云技能创建器生成技能，并提供评测、修复、安装与创建记录。需要 git、bash 与 python3，并能访问 gitcode.com（创建器与参考数据从那里拉取）；创建器默认以 danger-full-access 权限执行 shell 命令。

description.en: Connects the Tabby serial MCP bridge and registers a tabby-serial skill: the agent can list, open, read and write the serial ports already open in Tabby, and the same terminal keeps accepting your keystrokes while it works. Requires the tabby-serial-mcp plugin inside Tabby.
description.zh: 接入 Tabby 串口 MCP 桥接服务并注册 tabby-serial 技能：agent 可以列出、新建、读写 Tabby 里已经打开的串口，同时你还能在同一个终端里继续敲键盘。需要在 Tabby 里安装 tabby-serial-mcp 插件。

description.en: Lists RouterAI prompt, completion and cache-read prices per million tokens for the models configured in this profile, highlighting the active one. Requires a model provider whose config key is `routerai`; without it the table shows no data.
description.zh: 列出 profile 里各模型的 RouterAI 提示、补全和缓存读取价格（每百万 token），并高亮当前在用的那个。需要配置键为 routerai 的模型 provider；缺了表格不显示数据。

description.en: Chat with your Galatea assistant from QQ (official bot) and WeChat: the same conversation, persona and memory as on the desktop, only the paired owner's private chat is accepted, replies go back where you wrote, and more chat apps can be added. Requires the Galatea framework.
description.zh: 在 QQ（官方机器人）、微信上和 Galatea 助手聊天：和桌面是同一段对话、同一个人格和记忆，只接收配对本人的私聊，回复发回你说话的地方，可扩展更多聊天软件。需要先装 Galatea 框架。

description.en: Deletes a DSH session from the session menu, and lists the workspace files that session touched so you choose which ones to remove with it. Deletion is permanent (no undo), and files written through shell commands are not tracked.
description.zh: 在会话菜单里删除 DSH 会话，并列出该会话碰过的工作区文件，由你勾选哪些一起删掉。删除是永久的、无法撤销；通过 shell 命令写出的文件不在追踪范围内。

description.en: Let agents read and control the web page open in the right Sidebar Browser tab — read text, run JS, click (HTML and SVG), type, scroll, screenshot, with a per-command token bridge behind the Harness connection fence. Full control and screenshots need the DSH Desktop app; in a regular browser (Web) only same-origin pages can be read or scripted.
description.zh: 让 agent 读取并控制右侧 Sidebar 浏览器标签页里打开的网页——读文字、执行 JS、点击（HTML/SVG）、输入、滚动、截图，命令桥接带逐命令令牌并置于 Harness connection 防护栏之后。完整控制与截图需 DSH 桌面端；在普通浏览器（Web）中仅能读取或操控同源页面。

description.en: Send DSH event notifications to Gotify, a generic webhook, or ntfy when a task finishes, is interrupted, needs approval, or needs an answer. The message carries only the session title, workspace name and event reason, never the conversation body, and a failed send is logged without interrupting the session.
description.zh: 在任务完成、任务中断、需要审批、需要回答问题时，把 DSH 事件通知发到 Gotify、通用 Webhook 或 ntfy：通知只包含会话标题、工作区名称与事件原因，不包含会话正文；发送失败只写日志，不会打断会话。

description.en: 为DSH x64设计的win10科幻风HUD主题包,包含差分背景,代码雨,自定义内部组件接口,内置live2D,和大量高度可自定义化的功能
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上科幻 HUD 皮肤：视差背景、代码雨、Live2D 人物和可自由摆放的界面组件，整包离线可用。

description.en: 全能模式：跨项目、质量优先的 DeepSeek Harness 预设，支持能力感知推理和自适应信息保留。 / Omni mode: a quality-first, cross-project DeepSeek Harness preset with capability-aware reasoning and adaptive retention.
description.zh: 跨项目通用的高质量 Agent 预设，能按任务难度自动调整推理方式，并智能保留关键信息。

description.en: Adds a gradient background to sessions in the left session list so they are easier to tell apart.
description.zh: 给左侧会话列表的每一行加上渐变背景，一眼就能分清不同会话，避免点错。

description.en: Token usage & cost report for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): composer spend chip, per-day × per-model usage page, peak/off-peak pricing, date ranges, CSV export. Data stays local.
description.zh: 在输入框看实时花费，按天按模型查用量，支持峰谷价和 CSV 导出，数据只存本地。

description.en: 让 AI 直接调用 ffmpeg / ripgrep / fd / jq / yt-dlp：装工具、看实时控制台、归档脚本，一个页面搞定。
description.zh: 让 AI 直接调用 ffmpeg、ripgrep、fd、jq、yt-dlp 等命令行工具，装工具、看实时控制台、归档脚本一个页面全搞定。

description.en: A 56px always-on-top status strip for Windows that aggregates your Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity and DeepSeek Harness sessions: 4.17 MiB, no runtime dependencies, no account, no network.
description.zh: Windows 上常驻置顶的桌面小宠物，实时显示 AI 编码终端里 Agent 的运行状态，不用来回切窗口。

description.en: A session workspace for DeepSeek Harness modeled on the Claude app, with forked sessions nested in one tree, up to four sessions on one screen, and a right rail per pane.
description.zh: 参照 Claude 应用会话界面的 DSH 工作区：fork 会话收进一棵树，一屏最多四个会话并排，每屏带自己的右栏。

description.en: 阅藏：DeepSeek Harness 的双语论文阅读模式
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上双语论文阅读模式，看 PDF 时原文和译文对照着读，读文献更省劲。

description.en: Agent Scheduler for DeepSeek Harness: a lead agent that forks per input, long-lived worker agents, and a right-sidebar roster
description.zh: 主 Agent 按输入分叉，常驻 Worker 各管一摊，右侧栏随时查看调度情况。

description.en: AI-native SSH / Telnet / serial terminal for DeepSeek Harness — humans and AI agents share the same sessions, files and diagnostics. 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生 SSH / Telnet / 串口终端：人与 AI 共用会话、终端、文件与诊断。
description.zh: 让人类和 AI 共用同一个 SSH/Telnet/串口终端，会话、文件、诊断都能一起看、一起操作。

description.en: 亚马逊选品研究插件（DeepSeek Harness）：类目市场取数、五维评分（92 分制归一化）、1688 采价与全成本净利率、选品报告与侧栏面板
description.zh: 一键查亚马逊类目大盘和五维评分，算清1688采购全成本净利，直接出中文选品报告

description.en: Adds an Explain this action button under the permission approval card that asks the session model for a plain-language description of the pending operation — what it does, which files it touches, whether it modifies or deletes anything, and the privacy risk — plus a risk level and an allow or reject recommendation. Explanations are generated in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 在权限审批卡片下面加一个「解释这条操作」按钮：调用当前会话模型，把待批准的操作翻成大白话——做什么、碰哪些文件、会不会改动或删除、有没有隐私风险——再给出风险等级和允许或拒绝的建议。解释以简体中文生成。

description.en: Per-turn, per-file checkpoints for DeepSeek Harness: keep, undo, redo, and revert to here from a dock above the composer.
description.zh: 给每轮对话、每个文件自动打检查点，在输入框上方一键保留、撤销、重做或回退到某个版本。

description.en: Cognition HUD 是 DSH Web UI 上的一个实时「认知监视」浮层。 它把智能体正在做的事拆成三块同时呈现：一面会呼吸的方块墙——每段推理点亮格子、一道柔光横扫而过；一只在墙里游走、时不时起跳眨眼的小鲸鱼宠物；一组冷静的读数——工具意图、最近步骤、本轮用到的插件/技能/MCP，以及上下文与 token。
description.zh: 把智能体正在想什么实时画成方块墙、小鲸鱼和读数，一眼看清推理进度和 token 消耗。

description.en: Ordered/unordered list editing for the DeepSeek Harness composer: auto numbering, marker-aware caret moves, level promotion, undoable AI prompt polish.
description.zh: 给聊天输入框加上有序/无序列表编辑：自动续号重排、按标记移动光标、层级升降，还能一键优化提示词并撤销。

description.en: Self-contained DSH profile plugin that bridges the cua-driver 0.46.1 Windows kit into DSH as about 63 cua_* background desktop and browser automation tools (UIA observation, PostMessage input without focus stealing, CDP browser control, agent-cursor overlay, recording and diagnostics), with a bundled /cua-driver skill. Windows x64 only; bundles the prebuilt cua-driver.exe and starts it with --grant existing-profile, so the tools can attach to your already-running Edge or Chrome profile and act in its logged-in sessions.
description.zh: 让 DSH 能在后台操控 Windows 桌面和浏览器，自动完成点击、输入等操作。

description.en: Lightweight daily records for DeepSeek Harness: one JSON file per day, structured fields plus timestamped notes.
description.zh: 每天一个 JSON 文件，随手记录资产、支出、训练和睡眠，还能追加带时间戳的笔记。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：扫码登录抖音、归纳收藏视频、按时间批量取消收藏
description.zh: 让 Agent 帮你扫码登录抖音、归纳收藏视频，还能按时间批量取消收藏，默认先演练再执行。

description.en: Per-step thinking-effort pilot for DeepSeek Harness: cheap tool rounds stay cheap, failures and heavy work lift one step, agents can change their own depth without switching models.
description.zh: 按步骤自动调节思考深度，简单工具调用不浪费算力，遇到失败或重活自动加深，还能让智能体自己调档。

description.en: Multi-host SSH monitoring for the dsh web GUI: agentless metrics, hardware inventory, service probes, alerts, cron tasks, terminal, SFTP files, and agent tools. No agent to install, loopback-only.
description.zh: 不用装 agent，通过 SSH 就能在 dsh 网页里统一监控多台主机，看指标、查硬件、探服务、收告警、开终端传文件。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for building and testing Android apps on your phone.
description.zh: 在手机上让 Agent 帮你做 Android 应用，先预览效果，再打包成能独立安装的 App。

description.en: Graceful, idle-aware restart of the DSH host from inside a session: waits for every agent to finish, logs the causes, and wakes the requesting sessions after the restart.
description.zh: 在会话里安全重启 DSH 主机，等所有 agent 干完活再重启，还能把请求的会话唤醒。

description.en: HeroUI v3 theme builder for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop — live accent, base, font, radius and appearance controls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页和桌面端换 HeroUI v3 主题，强调色、字体、圆角、明暗都能实时调。

description.en: 用于bilibili的大肥鱼插件，支持ASR视频字幕读取，回复评论，主动阅读视频
description.zh: B站大肥鱼插件，能读视频字幕做带时间戳的总结，还会自动回复未读评论、定时发视频摘要。

description.en: 一个MCP管理插件，支持多种市面上的项目级MCP配置，也支持自定义预设。
description.zh: 让每个工作区按自己的项目级 MCP 配置独立连接服务器，不污染全局配置，也支持自定义预设。

description.en: Per-model, per-session header gate for DeepSeek Harness pi-ai requests: stamps configurable headers on calls to trusted origins, pinning each session's first decision. TDAI memory proxy identity headers are the shipped default; names, values and origins are configurable.
description.zh: 按模型和会话给 pi-ai 请求打上记忆身份头，首次选定后自动固定，省心又稳定。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 皮肤与壁纸插件：8 套预设、12 套自定义配色、9 套渐变；本地视频壁纸支持播放列表、进度拖动、整页全屏与声音。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换皮肤、换配色，还能用本地视频当壁纸，带播放列表和全屏。

description.en: Security score for every DeepSeek Harness plugin, skill and subagent: quarantine, six security scanners and an optional LLM judge
description.zh: 给每个插件、技能和子代理打安全分，先隔离再扫描，还能让大模型把关，防止恶意代码混进来。

description.en: DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) as a DSH sidebar panel: full main-area chat, last-conversation memory, crash containment.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接打开 DeepSeek 聊天，能记住上次对话，崩溃也不会拖垮主程序。

description.en: Dot for DeepSeek Harness: a personal chief-of-staff agent with memory, tasks, safety rules, a session dispatch desk and an on-screen pet. DSH 个人总管插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配个私人总管，帮你记事、盯任务、管会话，还带个桌面小宠物。

description.en: TellerU 白板讲解 · DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入 /whiteboard，AI 老师在右侧白板边写边讲
description.zh: 输入 /telleru 就能让 AI 老师在右侧白板边写边讲，把没看懂的概念讲透。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一只「费率表 + 缓存哨兵 + 输出压缩器」：真实 ¥ 账单、缓存失效告警与自动回滚、工具输出无损压缩、交接新会话（单请求 −94%）。
description.zh: 给 DSH 装上费率表、缓存哨兵和输出压缩器，实时看 ¥ 账单、缓存失效自动回滚，交接新会话单请求省 94%。

description.en: DSH plugin: normalize an omitted/undefined first argument for PTC run_code tool bindings. 修复 run_code 中 tools.foo() / tools.foo(undefined) 的 binding arguments 报错。
description.zh: 修复 run_code 里无参工具调用报错的问题，让 tools.foo() 和 tools.foo(undefined) 都能正常跑。

description.en: 一个DSH公网访问插件 把本机 DSH 安全暴露到公网的即插即用网关：密码/TOTP/邮箱验证码登录、暴破锁定、HTTPS 反向代理、设置页内配置面板，进程内零依赖。
description.zh: 把本机 DSH 安全开放到公网，自带密码、TOTP、邮箱验证码登录和 HTTPS 反向代理，开箱即用。

description.en: DSH Desktop 随手记：flomo 风格随手记录，邮箱文件夹跨设备同步。
description.zh: flomo 风格随手记，支持标签、搜索、Markdown 和图片，还能用自己的邮箱在多台电脑间同步笔记。
一眼看清 DeepSeek Harness 的额度用量和剩余情况，帮你随时掌握消耗、避免超额。

description.en: Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: rea MCP server behind a tool-filter proxy plus the vendored reverse-engineer-anything skill, all on one toggle.
description.zh: 一键开启逆向工程全套工具，MCP 服务加技能包都给你备好了，开箱就能用。

description.en: 屏幕彼端 · 住在屏幕另一端的 AI 小伙伴（DSH 插件；纯聊天可脱离 DSH 独立运行）
description.zh: 一个住在屏幕另一端的 AI 小伙伴，有自己的生活和记忆，能聊天、会主动找你，纯聊天可独立运行。

description.en: 给DSH工作区对话加上“删除”“多选”功能 Right-click delete + multi-select batch archive/delete for the DSH sidebar session list. Self-contained, no third-party plugin.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏会话加上右键删除和多选批量归档/删除，整理对话更省事。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：左侧栏 Steam 游戏库面板，展示游戏、游玩时长与成就进度，并为模型提供 get_my_steam_games 工具。
description.zh: 在侧边栏直接查看 Steam 游戏库、游玩时长和成就进度，还能让模型随时查你的游戏列表。

description.en: DSH插件：轻量多市场盯盘与持仓查看插件：悬浮胶囊 + A股/港股/美股/加密货币分组自选 + 持仓盈亏 + 目标价 + 分时/日周月K。数据存 DSH 实例（跨浏览器共享）。https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-stock-kanban
description.zh: 悬浮胶囊随时盯盘，A股港股美股加密货币分组自选，看持仓盈亏、目标价和分时K线，数据跨浏览器共享。

description.en: <Wuthering Waves Suoming theme> third-party DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme bundle
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换上《鸣潮》锁暝风格的红黑金国风皮肤，带立绘和机关伞装饰，设置还能记住。

description.en: DSH 视觉风格锁：10 种可切换的页面风格，用提示段 + 契约工具 + 自动校验强约束生成结果
description.zh: 给页面生成加把风格锁，10 种视觉风格任选，自动校验确保每次生成都不跑偏。

description.en: 生视频提示词库：整理 Seedance 2.5 和 Wan3 的中文视频提示词，用图谱、时间线和 Wiki 找灵感，也可以直接让 AI 按需求查参考。
description.zh: 整理 Seedance 2.5 和 Wan3 中文视频提示词，可浏览检索复制，也能让 AI 按需查参考找灵感。

description.en: 资产账本 | Multi-account, multi-asset, multi-currency portfolio & trade ledger plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 把股票、基金、券商账户统一记进一个账本，随时看总资产、账户分布和历史快照。

description.en: Mouse cursor skins for DeepSeek Harness: whale-girl white arrow and a maid-girl cursor, applied inside DSH or to Windows system cursors.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换鲸鱼娘鼠标皮肤，界面内即时生效，也能一键写入 Windows 系统光标。

description.en: Workspace-scoped durable memory for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让对话把分析代码学到的东西存进工作区，下个对话自动看到索引，需要时再读细节。

description.en: Delegate DSH tasks to independent Pi, Qoder and MiniMax Code workers through session-scoped MCP, with persistent sessions and a shared WebUI for results, events, approvals and cancellation. By default the Qoder and MiniMax Code workers run with every tool approval bypassed (change it with HARNESS_SUPERVISOR_QODER_PERMISSION_MODE and HARNESS_SUPERVISOR_MCODE_PERMISSION_MODE); DSH workers default to workspace-write with approval.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件加个总管，实时盯着运行状态、诊断问题，还能管会话和成本。

description.en: DSH 插件：侧边停靠的 Linux 指令解释与自然语言转指令工具，本地优先 + AI 兜底
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Linux 指令小助手，输入命令看中文解释，说出需求就给你一条能直接复制的命令，只解释不执行。

description.en: MOKI资料库 for DeepSeek Harness：本地文件管理、多格式预览与 Office / AI 选区协同编辑。Local file management, rich previews and precise AI editing for DSH.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个本地文件库，能预览各种格式，还能选中内容让 AI 精准改 Office 文档。

description.en: A TRAE-宝-style personal assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session long-term memory, auto-extracted candidate memories, first-time onboarding, a dedicated assistant agent preset, scheduled daily digest, desktop notifications, and a live overview panel.
description.zh: DSH 宝 —— TRAE 宝式个人助理插件：跨会话长期记忆、自动候选记忆提取、首次启动引导、专属助理 Agent 预设、定时每日简报、桌面通知与实时工作状态面板。

description.en: 基于playwright-cli的dsh桌面端侧边栏浏览器自动化操作插件
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面端侧边栏浏览器变成模型能稳定驱动的自动化工具，按标签页精准操作。

description.en: Session install radar for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 追踪每个 DSH 会话往电脑里装了什么，查清体积、位置和用途，防止空间悄悄被占。

description.en: 上下文清理大师：DSH 整蛊插件——一键清理悬浮球，扫描近期会话真实 token 消耗后开一个全新会话。A prank one-click context cleaner for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一键清掉悬浮球，扫描近期会话真实 token 消耗，再开个干净的新会话，整蛊又实用。

description.en: DSH plugin: a read-only PR and release workspace inside the sidebar — grouped PR lists, diffs, comments, local review notes, and six independent release facts.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里只读地查看 PR 列表、代码差异、评论和本地评审笔记，还能跟踪发布信息。

description.en: DSH plugin: download watermark-free Douyin and Xiaohongshu videos, transcribe with local or cloud ASR, proofread, and export Markdown/SRT/VTT/JSON/HTML/DOCX.
description.zh: 一键下载抖音无水印视频，自动转写校对文字，并导出多种格式文稿。

description.en: Agent Mail (腾讯智能体邮箱) client for DeepSeek Harness — sidebar panel, read/send/search, appearance settings, mail_* agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏直接收发、搜索腾讯智能体邮箱，还能调字体配色。

description.en: A task progress sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web and desktop, opened from the top-right Tasks button, with completion percentage, current step, status filters and task details; verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 with 0.2.1-rc.5 support.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web / 桌面客户端的任务进度侧栏：从右上角“任务”打开，查看完成比例、当前步骤，按状态筛选并展开待办详情；验证于 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1，兼容 0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: DSH plugin: plugin and Skill version management with verifiable snapshots
description.zh: 查看当前运行环境里的插件和 Skill 版本，还能生成可验证的快照，方便追踪和回滚。
每周日零点自动让模型识别工作区里散落的文件，按项目归进中文命名文件夹，只移动不删除。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness browser plugin for the installed Windows ego lite app: authenticated loopback HTTP, task spaces, page reading, clicks, form input and screenshots.
description.zh: 直接复用官方 ego lite 已登录的浏览器，让 DSH 能读页面、点按钮、填表单和截图。

description.en: Ctrl/Cmd+F in the conversation window to find loaded messages, highlight matches, move between them, and load earlier history from the find bar.
description.zh: 在会话窗口里按 Ctrl/Cmd+F 就能搜已加载的消息，高亮匹配、前后跳转，还能顺手加载更早的历史。
